tasks.title: Promote the seven staged migrations and regenerate DB types
tasks.dod: The seven Kysely migrations apply and revert cleanly on a fresh Postgres 16 and the regenerated db.types.gen.ts compiles.

tasks.title: Add platform primitives: error classes and codes, clock port, link tokens, config keys
tasks.dod: Unit tests prove every new error class maps to its code and HTTP status in the envelope, link tokens are 43-char base64url with a 32-byte SHA-256 hash, and config parses PUBLIC_WEB_URL and WEB_DIST_DIR.

tasks.title: Define the auth and workspaces zod contracts in packages/shared
tasks.dod: Unit tests show the shared schemas accept the openapi.yaml examples and reject an empty name, a non-email, and a password under 10 characters, and that no response schema has a token or link field except IssuedInvitation.link.

tasks.title: Implement the auth and workspaces domain rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover email normalisation, the 10–1024 password policy, the 10-in-15-minutes lockout window, invitation validity, and the last-active-owner rule, with no I/O.

tasks.title: Build the auth repositories and the argon2id password hasher
tasks.dod: Integration tests against Testcontainers Postgres pass for every auth repository method (scoped by account or normalised email), including the conditional reset-link consume, and the hasher round-trips argon2id PHC strings.

tasks.title: Build the workspaces repositories with cross-workspace isolation tests
tasks.dod: Every workspaces repository method has a Testcontainers test on twoWorkspaces() proving it never reads or changes the other workspace's rows, including the three controlled exceptions.

tasks.title: Implement the auth credential and session use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests with port fakes and a controllable clock show the same error for an unknown email and a wrong password, the lockout after 10 failures, sign-out ending only that session, and 30-day idle expiry that background requests do not extend.

tasks.title: Implement the password-reset link use cases
tasks.dod: Tests show issuing a link supersedes the earlier one, and redeeming it once ends every other session, clears the failure count, and signs the device in, while expired, used or superseded links are refused.

tasks.title: Implement create-workspace and re-issue-owner-invitation use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests show creating a workspace issues a 7-day owner invitation and returns its link once, invalid input creates nothing and names the field, and re-issuing supersedes the earlier invitation or refuses once members exist.

tasks.title: Implement invitation lookup and acceptance
tasks.dod: Tests cover the new-account path, the existing-password path, the wrong-email refusal, the 10-character refusal, the no-longer-valid refusal with the right whom-to-ask hint, and the lost race against a concurrent consume.

tasks.title: Implement workspace access: guard check, my workspaces, enter
tasks.dod: Unit tests show the guard returns { workspaceId, role } for an active member, NotFoundError when the account was never a member, and AccessRemovedError when the membership is deactivated, and that enter sets last_used_at, which getMe reports.

tasks.title: Implement the team use cases: invite, revoke, list, deactivate, reactivate
tasks.dod: Tests cover invite (with supersede), already-a-member, revoke, the team list without links, reactivation keeping the role, and two concurrent deactivations against Postgres where at most one leaves an active owner.

tasks.title: Expose the auth routes with the session cookie and resolver
tasks.dod: app.inject() integration tests show sign-in, sign-out, and reset lookup/redeem returning the openapi.yaml statuses and codes, byte-identical lockout responses for known and unknown emails, and session lifetime driven by a controllable clock.

tasks.title: Expose the workspace guard and the me / workspaces / enter routes
tasks.dod: app.inject() tests show getMe, listMyWorkspaces and enterWorkspace return the contract shapes, a foreign workspace answers 404 NOT_FOUND, and after a deactivation two open sessions both get 403 ACCESS_REMOVED while the member's other workspace still answers 200.

tasks.title: Expose the invitation lookup and acceptance routes
tasks.dod: app.inject() tests show lookUpInvitation and acceptInvitation answering 200/400/401/403/404 per openapi.yaml, with acceptance setting the session cookie.

tasks.title: Expose the owner-only team routes
tasks.dod: app.inject() tests show every team route returning its contract status, 403 OWNER_ONLY for an operator, and 404 for a session from another workspace.

tasks.title: Extract the shared dependency builder, serve the SPA from one origin, update the conventions docs
tasks.dod: buildApp() builds its modules through buildDeps(), the smoke test stays green, an inject test shows /w/<id>/team serving index.html when WEB_DIST_DIR is set, cookies are redacted in logs, and CLAUDE.md plus the architecture map describe the new conventions.

tasks.title: Build the admin CLI with its three commands
tasks.dod: Integration tests run each pnpm admin command against Testcontainers Postgres and assert the contracts/cli.md stdout, stderr, exit code, and audit line, with the link never logged.

tasks.title: Lay the web foundation: shadcn primitives, API client, shared guard handling, stores
tasks.dod: The ten shadcn primitives are installed with @/shared/lib/utils imports, and Testing Library tests show the guard handler reacting to 401, 403 ACCESS_REMOVED and 404 as the screens.md Shared guard states table says.

tasks.title: Build SCR-01 sign-in, the workspace resolution, SCR-05 no access and SCR-10 not found
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-01, SCR-05 and SCR-10 and show the AC-07 resolution choosing the return address, then the last-used workspace, the only workspace, the picker, or no access.

tasks.title: Build SCR-02 accept invitation and SCR-03 link unavailable
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-02 and the invitation variants of SCR-03 against mocked lookUpInvitation and acceptInvitation responses.

tasks.title: Build SCR-09 set new password
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-09 and the reset-link variant of SCR-03 against mocked lookup and redeem responses.

tasks.title: Build the AppShell, SCR-06 workspace home and SCR-04 picker / switcher
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-04 and SCR-06, show that operators get no Team link, and show switching calls enterWorkspace and drops the previous workspace's data.

tasks.title: Build SCR-07 team screen
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-07, including the confirm dialogs, last-active-owner, stale-row and owners-only states, and show that no invitation link is ever rendered.

tasks.title: Build SCR-08 invite member dialog
tasks.dod: Testing Library tests render every declared state of SCR-08, including the one-time link with Copy and its disappearance after Done once the pending list is refetched.

tasks.title: Add API-level end-to-end flows for every user story
tasks.dod: Seven multi-step flows run against ephemeral Postgres through the CLI command functions and HTTP only, never reading links or tokens from the database.

tasks.title: Add the six browser end-to-end flows and their CI step
tasks.dod: The six Playwright flows pass against the built SPA served same-origin with an ephemeral Postgres, run in a dedicated CI step, and stay out of pnpm test.
